display_name: Tamdhu 18 Year Old (Oloroso Sherry Cask Matured)
cask: Exclusively oloroso sherry-seasoned casks — combination of European and American oak, sourced from Jerez, Spain

tasting.nose: Dry nutty sherry, cherry and plum, milk chocolate, rum raisin, citrus and baked/honeyed oats; orange zest and hazelnut milk chocolate (per retailer notes).
tasting.palate: Rich, complex and decadently sherried — vanilla, brown sugar, red apple and dried fruits, deep nutty richness, dark chocolate and toasted almonds, with a characteristic dryness.

tasting.narrative: Tamdhu's 18 is the distillery's full-throttle oloroso statement: an exclusively sherry-matured Speysider that critics describe as a 'sherry bomb at the height of its greatness.' Dry, nutty and chocolate-rich rather than syrupy, it leans on European/American oak oloroso from Jerez at 46.8% ABV, natural colour and unchill-filtered. A San Francisco World Spirits Competition Double Gold backs the quality. Verdict: a benchmark sherried Speysider — though full tasting/scoring synthesis here is provisional pending verbatim source verification.
